title: Quotient coherence from invertible completed reduction arrows
statement: For any scheme morphism g:X→Y, Noetherian adic datum d, and derived input K over the completed coefficients on Y, assume each specified completedPullbackReductionArrow g d K n is invertible. Then every target quotient normalization is invertible; the actual limit-projection arrows satisfy the transition square after scalar adjunction and the normalization square before scalar adjunction. These target normalizations satisfy the three-index quotient cocycle and equal-index unit equation with exactly completedReductionQuotientAssoc and completedReductionUnit. No completeness hypothesis on K is needed.

proof.text: Compute derived limit projections on a K-injective strict tower. The ordinary equation limit.w shows that the b projection followed by the b-to-a tower transition is the a projection. Compose with the finite-evaluation compatibility equation to obtain the square of the specified restricted finite arrows.

Transpose this square through the scalar adjunctions. Uniqueness of normalized composite adjunctions identifies the transpose with the specified source normalization and target normalization. The normalization square exhibits the target normalization as a composite of isomorphisms, since both finite arrows and the source normalization are invertible.

Prove associativity of source normalizations with leftAdjointCompIso_assoc and the coefficient quotient composition identity. Substitute the normalization squares, use naturality of scalar associativity, and cancel the invertible finite arrow to get the target quotient cocycle. For equal indices, express source normalization via the scalar counit and the restriction identity; counit naturality and the same cancellation prove the specified unit equation.
